title: Near-Optimal Sparsifiers for Stochastic Knapsack and Assignment Problems
review_status: full-text audit complete; polyhedral sparsification theorem, activation assumptions, synthetic evaluation protocol/results/anomaly, and real-benchmark limitations checked
sections_checked: Polyhedral sparsification definition and informal/main theorem
Section 4.4 synthetic evaluation, generator design, aggregate metrics and anomalous slice
Conclusion and open question for general ILPs
evidence_note: Dimension-independent polynomial-in-1/p,1/epsilon degree guarantees for specified packing problems under independent activation. Synthetic deterministic p=1 tests report 0.998 average approximation and 2.79x average speedup, with stronger filtered high-redundancy slices; n=10000,m=5 anomaly is attributed by the authors to the generator. Existing benchmark/hard GAP cases are noted to be sparse. No real-world workload validation.

title: Refining the Complexity Landscape of Speed Scaling: Hardness and Algorithms
review_status: full-text audit complete; four variant complexity results, priority/completion-order distinction, counterexamples to prior k-speed extension, and approximation directions checked
sections_checked: Abstract and definitions of speed-scaling variant tuple
Counterexamples to two natural k-speed extensions and Discussion/Future Work
evidence_note: Four unresolved flow/energy scheduling variants are shown NP-hard even with prescribed priority order; all considered variants with given completion-time order are polynomial-time solvable by LP. Authors give counterexamples to two natural generalizations of a prior two-speed algorithm. The results concern worst-case complexity, not measured energy impact.

title: Estimating Size of the Union of Sets in Streaming Model
review_status: full-text audit complete; Delphic-set assumptions, streaming applications, complexity results, later revision/Lean formalization note, and insertion-only/oracle boundaries checked
sections_checked: Abstract and Delphic set definition/application mapping
NP-oracle hashing estimator and space lower-bound discussion
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2026-07-29; substantially revised from PODS 2021 paper, DOI 10.1145/3452021.3458333
evidence_note: Insertion-only estimator applies to Delphic set families with efficient membership/sampling/counting. Klee's measure update time linear in dimension; a separate test-coverage space improvement uses an NP oracle. 2026 revision reports fixed proof bugs, formal theorem statements, and Lean 4 machine checking while asserting main claims unchanged. No implementation benchmark; oracle and stream-model restrictions matter.
